name: betha435
tour: Jajce & Travnik Day Trip from Sarajevo
text: Outstanding all day tour from Sarajevo. It was the best day seeing sites in Travnik and Jajce. We experienced true Bosnian coffee and food as well as seeing absolutely beautiful waterfalls and water mills. Our guide made this tour very personal. We highly recommend this tour for a tour to experience Bosnia. Thank you ever so much.

name: Gerwinpol
text: Had an amazing experience with out tour guide Almedin Memovic. As a local he was really able to show us the complexity of the war, and the difficulties that the local population had to cope with. Through anecdotes and personal stories he was able to bring across information in an entertaining and informative way. I can definetly recommend booking your tour here :)

name: Traveler21century
text: This was a really fun tour to take on our first night in Sarajevo, that happened to be New Year's Eve. Almedin Memovic ("Tallest Tour Guide") is a lot of fun, he knows very well the story of the shooting which started World War I. He also knows good places to hang out if you need a rest. He showed us the main sites in the Old City and told stories with passion, emphasizing the positive relationship between the Christian, Muslim and Jewish communities.

name: Petwall
tour: Top Secret Sarajevo War Tunnel Tour
text: Interesting tour and knowledgeable guide that could give the background in a comprehensive way. Good to know a bit about the sad history to not have it repeated again.

name: kmddd
text: I went on the 10:00 Sarajevo walking tour. We covered most of Stari Grad including major historical landmarks, the market, and a cathedrals and mosques. Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and included a lot of personal anecdotes from his life having grown up in Sarajevo. Highly recommend!

name: Katarína R
text: Amazing guide, nice a atmosphere, authentique guy with a sensor of humo, good advices about local places and event. I highly recommend!!!

name: Sandy L
text: Almedin Memovic was brilliant in his explanations, historical overview & insights. He answered every question & presented his own memories as a child in the war. Couldn’t have asked for a better guide!

name: Marianna P
tour: Top Secret Sarajevo War Tunnel Tour
text: The tour with Meme was great, Sarajevo is one of the most and beautiful city I have ever been to. But the best was Meme him self, so committed and passionate to his city, his story and his job. At the same time ironical and thoughtful, with him we had definitely an amazing time in Sarajevo. We shared deep conversation and super fun moments. We also joined with him and his friend the first pride ever in Sarajevo, an unforgettable experience. I am very grateful to this guy, whose kindness exceeds the stature.

name: Cary P
text: We were a group of 3 adults and one 9 year old on a walking tour with Eldar. He did an excellent job of presenting the history and geography of Sarajevo as we visited many, various spots. He engaged with all of us, kept the pace pleasant, and was so very knowledgeable. We learned so much and felt like we were out and about with a local who loves his city and loves sharing his city.

name: Nenad R
text: We did a 2 hour free walking tour with Nikola. He didn't cancel the tour although it was just a two of us with a 7 months old. So, besides being brave enough to be our guide with such a small baby he was very knowledgable and presented the facts in a very interesting way. If you decide to take a walking tour around Sarajevo, make sure you don't miss this one. Great experience!

name: F7111NAtomb
text: We ended up being the only 2 joining the free walking tour but he still went with us despite the obvious low revenue he would generate from 2 people. He was very nice, knew a lot and gave us a lot.of insight into the city. He even took us for bosnian coffee, it was so nice. Great experience and we recommend it to anyone going to sarajevo

name: MarkCBurbank
text: My tour guide was Eldar. The tour was very good and at the correct pace for maximum enjoyment. I learned a lot and Eldar was great in showing me the highlights of his city. Thank you Eldar I really appreciate your expertise and your hospitality on the tour.

name: Erika P
text:
We had a tour with Meme on the 6th March 2020, in Sarajevo. The tour was focused on the war period and covered in detail the siege of the city. We booked through "FreeTour" page online and, as per the standard rules, these tours only take place when at least 4 people join. However, when we reached the office and Meme welcomed us, it was just me and my boyfriend. Meme immediately gave us the availability to make the tour even with just the two of us, so we had what we could call a "private" tour. It was simply outstanding: Meme was incredibly prepared to tell us everything about the war period and the siege. Not only he was born during the siege itself, but he studied the events a lot and gave us an overview of the siege which linked a neutral historical narration with his personal experience. He shared with us all his knowledge with a professional attitude but also with a friendly and touching approach, which made us feel part of the story of the city even if it was the first time we were visiting it. He also shared with us some memories of his childhood, of his family and of his story, which made us feel as we were friends, rather than two tourists with a guide. We loved the tour from the first minute to the last one and we are grateful to Mere for his outstanding ability to make us feel home. One of the best tours ever. FULLY RECOMMENDED.

Abbiamo fatto un tour con Meme il 6 Marzo 2020 a Sarajevo. Il tour era incentrato sulla guerra avvenuta a Sarajevo ed in particolare sull'assedio che la città ha subito tra il '92 e il '95.

Abbiamo prenotato il tour tramite "FreeTour" e nonostante tali tour vengano svolti con un minimo di 4 partecipanti, Meme é stato molto disponibile a svolgere il tour per sole due persone. Abbiamo avuto la percezione in seguito divenuta sicurezza durante il tour che Meme fosse un ragazzo preparato, professionale e disponibile a condividere in maniera oggettiva i fatti avvenuti al tempo dell'assedio condividendo al contempo spaccati della sua vita privata e delle sue esperienze personali, essendo nato e cresciuto durante l'assedio stesso. Siamo davvero soddisfatti di aver preso parte a questo tour e raccomandiamo decisamente Meme come guida. Semplicemente FANTASTICO.

name: wplesser
text: Very good tour. Excellent guide Damir. Very knowledgable, flexible and sympathetic. Happy to recommend.

name: Norbert M
text: The free tour was excellent, we really enjoyed it. It was 2 hours long and we walked about 4 km. The historic facts and stories were quite interesting and we learnt a lot about the Yugoslavian war. Highly recommended!

name: Albert P
tour: Sarajevo Siege War Tour | Tunnel, Bobsled Track & Jewish Cemetery
text: We learned a lot about the site to the city of Sarajevo between 1992 and 1995. The guide did a spectacular job to tell us a version as objective as possible and also with a little personal view about life in times of war in the city. The tour passes through some of the most relevant points of that period and the 2 hours become really enjoyable thanks to the great attitude of Meme :)

name: P9237RDmarcj
text:
Almedin is passionate about Sarajevo, his home and a city that everyone thinks that they know a bit about (the assassination that led to WW1, the Winter Olympics, the recent civil wars) but that is, actually, only a small part of the story. This small but fascinating melting-pot of a city has much to see and the sunset tour was perfect for me as I was on a tight programme. Almedin, who seems to know everyone in Sarajevo, takes you off the main touristy routes and shows you streets and workshops that could be in Marakech or Istanbul, as well as more baroque/classically European areas. Almedin is perfect at juding his tourists, and knows precisely the right bar/shop to go to for a rest (and all of the tourist routes).

My highlights were the Jewish quarter, where Almedin regaled me with how the religious communities worked together to preserve ancient items that the Nazis were desperate to aquire, the simple, rather modest memorials to the fallen in the infamous siege (one memorial in particular, from 1992, showed, from the names of the victims, how indescriminate war is) and, left to the end, the site of the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand. During our tour two things shone through: Almedin's astonishing level of knowledge (he never failed to answer my questions) and his passion for tour guiding. I have done a few of these walking tours, from Berlin to Lisbon and Marackech, and this was, easily, the best.

I would also add that Sarajevo is a hidden gem - less publicised than other tourist spots (your Dubrovoniks and Venices, for example!) but a wonderful city with charming, welcoming hosts and stacks of stuff to see. And the Tallest Tourguide company is highly recommended to do help you see it...

name: borjalh
text: I did the Siege of Sarajevo tour with Meme. He is one of the best tour guides I have ever been with! Not only I learned from the history of Sarajevo and the war but also I enjoyed so much that it felt really short. I also appreciate Meme's own vision and his personal touch. I totally recommend this tour if you want to learn about Sarajevo and see the top spots.

name: SarahZorko
text: The Sarajevo Siege walking tour was the best we’ve ever experienced, by far. Almedin is very knowledgeable, nuanced, and sarcastic (in the best way, with humour). He gave us fantastic and detailed historical context as well as stories from his family and friends at the time of the siege. He was very unbiased. We can’t stress enough how much he knew the topic and how fun he managed to make this tour, despite the complexity and sadness of the situation. We really can’t recommend this tour enough. We also did the General Sarajevo Free Tour with him and it was also fantastic. Our overall experience of Sarajevo would not have been as great had we not taken his tours. Thank you Almedin! (We know how intense this sounds, but it is our honest opinion)

name: Annette V
text: Sehr schöner Stadtspaziergang mit persönlichen Erinnerung des Guide und sehr viel geschichtlichem Input. Hat sehr viel Spass gemacht, die Zeit verging unfassbar schnell.

name: Emma L
text: Knowledgeable and friendly guide. Takes the time to explain things and shows interesting and exciting places. Showed us the best of Sarajevo and sights along the way to Mostar. Attentive to the group and shows a strong willingness to share his city and its history. Highly recommended!

name: Marc J.
text: Almedin takes you off the main touristy routes and shows you streets and workshops that could be in Marrakech or Istanbul. His astonishing level of knowledge never failed to answer my questions. I have done walking tours from Berlin to Lisbon and Marrakech. This was, easily, the best.

name: Michael P.
text: Meme has enough knowledge to write a library, delivered with stunning detail. He has a great sense of humour, a sunny disposition, and is generally a lovely guy. He even got us some mandarines from the market — from Cyprus with love.

name: Georgie K.
text: There are some travel experiences that you treasure for life — that's what we had with Tallest Tourguide. Meme spent his Saturday evening helping plan my husband's 30th birthday, including a birthday cake in Bosnia's highest village. He came in on his day off to give us the best tour of our lives.

name: Emma L.
text: Knowledgeable and friendly guide. Showed us the best of Sarajevo and the sights along the way to Mostar. Attentive to the group and genuinely passionate about sharing his city and its history. Highly recommended!

name: Mahmoud P.
text: We did the Siege Tour in March 2019. When I made a booking mistake, Meme was incredibly flexible — and more than made up for it with the tour itself. He explained the history of the Siege from all angles, making something deeply complex still understandable. This wasn't just a tour; it's something we'll carry with us.

name: Francesca R
tour: At the Family Table: Home-hosted Dinner
text:
I have just moved to Bosnia, so this dinner was the perfect introduction to the country's culture and traditions.
It was a wonderful experience to enjoy authentic Bosnian home cooking in such a warm and welcoming family atmosphere. Every dish was delicious and prepared with so much care.
What made the evening even more special were the conversations around the table, the genuine kindness of the family, and the opportunity to practise a little Bosnian. I felt welcomed from the very first moment.
At the end of the evening, the mother even gave me some homemade juice to take with me—a small gesture that perfectly reflects Bosnian hospitality. I couldn't have wished for a better welcome to my new home. I highly recommend this experience to anyone who wants to discover the real Bosnia beyond the usual tourist attractions.
